name: conversations_invite
description: Invites users to a channel; users is a comma-separated list that fans out to one membership row each, with users_not_found validation (POST /conversations.invite)

channel.description: The ID of the public or private channel to invite user(s) to.

users.description: A comma separated list of user IDs. Up to 1000 users may be listed, e.g. U0000001,U0000005.
